description: This source file defines the CommandResolver enum in Swift, which provides various static methods for resolving and executing OpenClaw commands, managing project paths, SSH remote execution, and configuration handling within a macOS application.

methods.name: gatewayEntrypoint
methods.description: Determines the entry point script for the gateway based on the project directory.

methods.name: runtimeResolution
methods.description: Resolves the runtime environment using stored paths.

methods.name: makeRuntimeCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command array to execute a particular runtime with specified entry point and subcommand.

methods.name: runtimeErrorCommand
methods.description: Creates a command array that outputs a runtime resolution error message.

methods.name: errorCommand
methods.description: Generates a shell command that outputs an error message and exits.

methods.name: projectRoot
methods.description: Determines the project root directory, using stored preferences or fallback directories.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Stores the specified project root path in user defaults.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the path of the current project root as a string.

methods.name: preferredPaths
methods.description: Generates a list of preferred executable paths considering environment variables, user paths, and project-specific paths.

methods.name: openclawManagedPaths
methods.description: Returns paths managed by OpenClaw, such as local bin directories.

methods.name: nodeManagerBinPaths
methods.description: Returns paths to Node.js version managers' binary directories.

methods.name: versionedNodeBinPaths
methods.description: Lists binary directories for specific Node.js versions found in directories.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches for an executable in provided or preferred paths.

methods.name: openclawExecutable
methods.description: Finds the openclaw CLI executable within provided paths.

methods.name: projectOpenClawExecutable
methods.description: Checks for the openclaw executable within a project directory, likely for development.

methods.name: nodeCliPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the node CLI script if available.

methods.name: hasAnyOpenClawInvoker
methods.description: Checks if any method to invoke openclaw exists (local or globally accessible).

methods.name: openclawNodeCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command line to execute openclaw via Node.js, considering remote SSH or local paths.

methods.name: openclawCommand
methods.description: Wrapper for openclawNodeCommand to get the command array.

methods.name: sshNodeCommand
methods.description: Constructs an SSH command to run openclaw remotely.

methods.name: connectionSettings
methods.description: Retrieves remote connection settings from defaults and configuration.

methods.name: connectionModeIsRemote
methods.description: Checks if remote mode is enabled based on user defaults.

methods.name: sanitizedTarget
methods.description: Cleans and trims SSH target strings.

methods.name: parseSSHTarget
methods.description: Parses SSH target strings into user, host, and port components.

methods.name: sshTargetValidationMessage
methods.description: Validates an SSH target string and provides error messages if invalid.

methods.name: shellQuote
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe inclusion in shell commands.

methods.name: expandPath
methods.description: Expands a file path string, handling ~ to home directory expansion.

methods.name: normalizeSSHTargetInput
methods.description: Normalizes SSH target input by removing 'ssh ' prefixes and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isValidSSHComponent
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid SSH component (hostname or username).

methods.name: makeSSHTarget
methods.description: Creates an SSHParsedTarget object from user, host, and port, validating components.

methods.name: sshTargetString
methods.description: Constructs the SSH target string from components.

methods.name: sshArguments
methods.description: Generates a list of arguments for the ssh command, including options, identity, and remote command.
